## Activity

The activity record for West Gate Eye Clinic covers November 2022. The clinic completed 381 captures during the month. This provides the reported volume of imaging activity for the site and establishes the basis for the image-quality and grading results set out below.

## Image quality

Of the 381 captures, 21 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 5.5 per cent. These images could not be used for grading and should continue to be monitored as part of routine site review. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk so that they can be reviewed and addressed through the appropriate operational process.

## Grading

There were 80 referable results during November 2022. The median grading lag was 2 days. The results should be considered alongside the ungradable activity when reviewing the clinic’s overall performance. Continued monitoring of image quality, grading volumes and the grading lag will support timely identification of any operational issues at West Gate Eye Clinic.
